profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a public company headquartered in Tel Aviv that trades under the ticker WIX and operates wix.com. According to its own site, it offers a free website builder that the company describes as easy to use, with more than 2,000 templates, built-in AI tools, and a custom domain. The site also says users can sell products, services, and memberships from a single dashboard without plugins, and that specialized AI agents are available to help keep a business growing.

The company's AI position, as presented on its site, rests on AI tools built into the website builder and on AI agents aimed at business operations rather than on separately named AI products. No litigation, no AI products tracked separately, and no MCP servers are recorded for the company. Its registration details list it as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001576789.
